title: Single-Lane Execution Reliability and Validation Compression
owner_directive: Audit every tranche completed on 2026-09-20, remove reintroduced overhandling, make one owner Continue reliably span the full bounded tranche, and optimize the current single-active-lane period without weakening exact-head validation or protected-main publication.

observed_day.measurement_limitation: Checkpoint continue_turns undercounts known fragmentation; GPR-07 and GPR-09 are confirmed examples where later closeout data normalized the count back to one.

root_causes: Terminal-response enforcement consults checkpoint state that is stale during live execution instead of treating lane-state execution_status as the hard response gate.
Repeated owner Continues are not durably recorded at the lane-state boundary, allowing final checkpoint telemetry to undercount or erase fragmentation.
AIOC Validate Operations V3 replays the entire terminal MVPS/Core-26/content pipeline suite for ordinary GPR/OARC/MRCS closeouts unrelated to those assets.
Healthy CI has repeatedly been polled and narrated at per-platform/job granularity despite OPS3-11 prohibiting that overinstrumentation.
Parallel-lane reconciliation complexity persisted after MRCS and OARC became terminal; current execution has one nonterminal persistent lane.
external_patterns_reviewed: GitHub REST best practices: prefer webhooks/events to polling; when polling is unavoidable, minimize frequency and data.
GitHub Actions workflow_run: event-driven continuation after workflow completion.
Temporal durable execution: resume exactly from persisted workflow state after process/session interruption.
AWS Step Functions callback/sync patterns: wait on durable external completion rather than keeping a client-side loop alive.
AWS retry guidance: bounded retries with backoff and changed evidence, not tight retry loops.
repair_scope: Make durable lane-state execution_status the terminal-response gate.
Add owner_continue_count and exceptional owner-reentry recording to lane state without converting it back into an activity log.
Carry truthful Continue counts through successor reseed so closeout cannot silently normalize fragmentation.
Define derived single-active-lane mode and quiet execution behavior while keeping the three persistent slots as history/topology.
Scope heavy MVPS/Core-26/content-pipeline validation only to commits that touch those dependent surfaces.
Preserve exact-head Linux/Windows/deterministic application validation, READY publication, protected-main rules and bounded closeout.
next_action: OPS3-12 is closed. Resume GPR-10 only; single-active-lane quiet execution is now canonical and product starts are unfrozen.
